title: The exact region between Chatterjee's $ξ$ and Blomqvist's $β$
summary: We determine the exact region of Chatterjee's rank correlation $ξ$ and Blomqvist's $β$, that is, the set of all pairs $(ξ(C),β(C))$ where $C$ ranges over all bivariate copulas. The region equals $\{(x,y)\in[0,1]\times[-1,1]:|y|^3\le2x\}$, so every copula satisfies the sharp inequality $|β(C)|^3\le2ξ(C)$. Its left boundary $ξ=|β|^3/2$ is attained uniquely by an explicit family of copulas that perturb independence by a signed tent function centered at the median, and its right boundary $ξ=1$ by deterministic interval-exchange copulas.
